# SmartOne

> SmartOne makes Android payment devices for European small businesses: a card payment terminal with a built-in receipt printer and the Merchant Portal, and in Malta a VAT-approved fiscal cash register in the same device. SmartOne serves Malta, Spain, Cyprus, Slovakia and the United Kingdom.

Approval: VAT-approved fiscal cash register in Malta — Government Gazette No. 21,373, Notice 46, 10 January 2025.

Key facts:
- 200,000+ SmartOne terminals deployed worldwide; SmartOne projects in 15 countries.
- One terminal model per country, as listed below.
- Transparent pricing: every fee shown up front. No settlement fees, no inactivity fees, no monthly minimums.
- Payouts go to the merchant's own existing bank account, next business day (T+1). Payments are processed by a licensed payment partner.
- The Merchant Portal shows net amounts and the commission actually paid for every settlement.
- Usually live in 4 business days or less from your request, including fiscal registration of the device where the market requires it.

## Countries
The site serves every country from the same URLs; the visitor picks a country, and pages without a choice show Malta.
- Malta: the SmartOne Bank Pro S (dual-screen) card terminal with the VAT-approved fiscal cash register built in — fiscal receipts and Z-reports on the same device. Live today, with our partner in Malta.
- Spain: the SmartOne Bank (5″) payment terminal, Verifactu-ready ahead of the 2027 deadline. Site in English, Spanish, Ukrainian and Russian.
- Cyprus: the SmartOne Bank Pro payment terminal — card payments and compliant receipts on one device.
- Slovakia: the SmartOne Bank Pro payment terminal, ready for local fiscal requirements.
- United Kingdom: the SmartOne Bank Pro payment terminal — card payments and the Merchant Portal; no fiscal register is required.
